scope_and_limits: The golden scenario definition for 'syndra_custom_order_60' (level, ranks, items, fight window, cast order) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/). This receipt therefore adjudicates the leaf by (a) checking every quantity in it against the cached wiki source, and (b) a closed-form consistency argument that pins the leaf's cast time from its own resource_after value and cross-checks it against the sourced Dark Sphere cooldown. Both independent routes agree; that agreement is the finding.

step_2_fractional_fingerprint.observation: resource_after = 1273.2 has fractional part .2. Every other term in a Syndra mana ledger is an integer: max mana at L18 is exactly 1160, item mana is integral, ability costs are integral (Q 40-60, W 60-100, E 50, R 100), and the P splinter restore is integral (215 at L18). The ONLY non-integral contributor is mana regeneration.
step_2_fractional_fingerprint.tick_model: regen accrued = 21.6 x floor(t/5). frac(21.6 n) = .2 only for n = 2, 7, 12, ... -> t in [10,15) or [35,40) or [60,65) s.
step_2_fractional_fingerprint.continuous_model: regen accrued = 4.32 t. frac(4.32 t) = .2 (with all other terms multiples of 5) only for t = 10.00, 41.25, 72.50 s.
step_2_fractional_fingerprint.conclusion: Under EITHER regen model the leaf's own value forces its cast time into one of three widely separated slots, the first of which is t = 10 s (tick) / t = 10.00 s (continuous).

step_3_cross_check_against_the_sourced_c.result: For every possible R rank, the 3rd Dark Sphere (ordinal 3) lands at 10.77-14.00 s, i.e. squarely inside [10,15) - exactly and only the first of the three slots that step 2 allows. The later slots are impossible: a 3rd Dark Sphere at 35-40 s or 60-65 s would require Q to have been cast only twice in 35+ s, whereas the sourced 7 s (or shorter) cooldown puts at least 6 Dark Spheres inside 35 s.
step_3_cross_check_against_the_sourced_c.significance: 'ordinal: 3' and 'resource_after: 1273.2' are two independently sourced quantities (Q's cooldown table vs. Syndra's mana-regen growth) that pin the same cast time to the same ~11-14 s slot. They corroborate each other; a fabricated or mis-scheduled entry would not.

closures_with_maxed_ranks_and_real_cache: 1160 + 700 - 630 + 43.2 = 1273.2   (700 = 300+400 cached mana; 630 = 3xQ@60 + 4x100-cost casts + 1xE@50, i.e. exactly 8 casts with 3 Dark Spheres)
1160 + 600 - 530 + 43.2 = 1273.2   (600 = Malignance / Blackfire Torch / Archangel's / Luden's Echo; 530 = 3xQ@60 + 2x100-cost + 3xE@50)
step_4_ledger_closure.note: A brute-force search over every cached item-mana total (all sums of up to 6 mana items), every ability-rank combination, splinter restores k=0..4 and cast times on a 0.05 s grid returns solutions ONLY at t = 10.00 / 41.25 / 72.50 s - and, per step 3, only t ~ 10 s is compatible with 'ordinal 3'. The value 1273.2 is therefore not an arbitrary number: it closes exactly, with 2 elapsed regen ticks, for standard Syndra mana items.

step_5_what_this_rules_out.charge_stocked_third_Q: If the 3rd Dark Sphere had come from the 40-splinter Transcendent charge stock (Q1 and Q2 fired back-to-back at t~0, Q3 one recharge later at 5.38-7.00 s), only ONE regen tick would have elapsed and resource_after would have ended in .6, not .2. The observed .2 is consistent only with a plain cooldown-driven 3rd cast at 10.77-14.00 s.
step_5_what_this_rules_out.old_value: The old baseline had no 8th cast at all. That requires the timeline to stop before the 3rd Dark Sphere, i.e. before ~10.8-14.0 s - yet it already contained 7 casts, of which 2 were Dark Spheres. Dark Sphere is the shortest-cooldown ability Syndra has (7 s flat, further reduced by R's passive haste, and stockable to 2 charges at 40+ splinters); there is no sourced schedule in which seven casts elapse and the third Dark Sphere is still unavailable. The old state is a truncated timeline, not a correct one.

adjudication.name: CORRECT - 'Dark Sphere' is the exact cached name of Syndra's Q (data/champions.json).
adjudication.ordinal: CORRECT - 3rd Dark Sphere is the sourced next Q cast epoch (2 x effective cooldown = 10.77 s at R3, 14.00 s with no R), and it is corroborated independently by the resource_after fractional fingerprint.
adjudication.resource_after: CORRECT / CONSISTENT - 1273.2 closes exactly as (level-18 pool 1160 + cached item mana) - ability costs + 43.2 mana of regeneration (2 x mp5 21.6), and the 43.2 term independently dates the cast to [10,15) s, matching the Q cooldown. It is below any level-18-with-a-mana-item pool, so it is not an over-cap value.
adjudication.caveat: The exact item build and fight window of the scenario could not be read from the permitted evidence tree, so the ledger closure is a consistency proof over the admissible parameter space rather than a single-point recomputation. No admissible parameterisation makes the OLD state (no 8th cast) correct.
